summary: Karney geodesic + Sutherland-Hodgman + multi-source DEM math all check out at HEAD 28f7942; only doc-drift findings remain (agent.md path map and cross-validate tolerance disagree with code).

findings.title: agent.md high_risk_globs reference nonexistent paths (genoa/src/engine/geodesy/**, coverage/polygon_clip.js)
findings.recommended_fix: Replace 'genoa/src/engine/geodesy/**' with 'genoa/src/engine/geometry/**' (wgs84.js, geodesic.js, karneyArea.js, polygon.js, polygonOverlap.js all live there). Replace 'genoa/src/engine/coverage/polygon_clip.js' with 'genoa/src/engine/geometry/polygonOverlap.js' (Sutherland-Hodgman convex clip + buildContourPolygon live there, not under coverage/). Same fix already enumerated in PD-002 PR-C; close the loop with a canonical finding so it dedupes against future runs.
findings.reproducibility_notes: ls genoa/src/engine/ shows no geodesy/ directory and no coverage/polygon_clip.js; geometry/ owns wgs84.js / geodesic.js / karneyArea.js / polygon.js / polygonOverlap.js. Checklist validates the right invariants — only path map is wrong.

findings.title: CROSS_VALIDATE_TOLERANCE_M drift — agent.md says 25 m default, elevationClient.js uses 30 m
findings.recommended_fix: Lock the constant in one place. Recommend 30 m in BOTH places (agree with code): §73.313 arc-averages 27 samples per radial, single-pixel 30-m disagreement averages well below the published HAAT precision; the 'minor variations' clause does not require <25 m sample-level agreement; existing fixtures already pass at 30 m. Either way, export CROSS_VALIDATE_TOL_M from elevationClient.js and cite it in agent.md, don't restate.
findings.reproducibility_notes: elevationClient.js:107 sets CROSS_VALIDATE_TOL_M = 30; agent.md checklist item 1 documents 'default 25 m'. No exhibit silently flips at the 25–30 m band today, but a future operator reading only the agent doc will mis-tune.
